Title: Successful order placement with saved address and valid Credit Card
Preconditions: User is logged in as registered customer; Cart contains 2 in-stock items ($85 total); User has at least 1 saved valid shipping address
Steps:
1. Navigate to cart page and click 'Proceed to Checkout'
2. Select default shipping address from address radio group
3. Select 'Credit Card' as payment method
4. Enter valid Visa card number, expiration date, and CVV
5. Click 'Place Order' button
Expected Result: User redirected to /order-confirmation with unique Order ID and confirmation email sent notification

Title: Apply valid promotional discount code and verify recalculation
Preconditions: User is on checkout page with items totaling $100; Promo code 'SAVE20' is active in promotion system
Steps:
1. Enter 'SAVE20' into Promo Code text input
2. Click 'Apply' button
3. Observe Order Summary totals breakdown
Expected Result: Success message 'Promo SAVE20 applied (-$20.00)' displayed; Subtotal unchanged, Discount -$20.00, Total adjusted correctly

Title: Checkout rejected when credit card CVV length is invalid
Preconditions: User is on checkout payment section
Steps:
1. Select 'Credit Card'
2. Enter valid 16-digit card number and future expiration date
3. Enter '1' (single digit) into CVV field
4. Click 'Place Order'
Expected Result: Inline field validation error 'CVV must be 3 or 4 digits' displayed; Order is not submitted and payment gateway is not contacted

Title: Expired promo code displays inline error without resetting cart
Preconditions: Promo code 'SUMMER2025' is marked expired in backend
Steps:
1. Enter 'SUMMER2025' into Promo Code input
2. Click 'Apply'
Expected Result: Alert message 'Promo code has expired' displayed; Total remains unchanged and all entered address details remain intact

Title: Inventory depletion during checkout payment processing
Preconditions: Cart contains 1 item with remaining inventory count = 1
Steps:
1. User fills checkout details and clicks 'Place Order'
2. Concurrent shopper completes purchase of the last stock item 100ms earlier
Expected Result: Order fails gracefully with alert 'Item is no longer in stock'; Payment is not charged; User returned to cart with item flagged
